sections.heading: 1. Adjust your setup
lines: ① Use desk risers or a sit-stand desk.
② Set hips level with or above your knees.
③ Car seat back and down, backrest upright.
④ At low benches, hinge from the hips.

sections.heading: 2. Get checked promptly if…

bladder or bowel changes — seek care fast.

caption:
Desk, chair, car and kitchen bench: for Lulu, everything is built for someone shorter.

Low desks, short chair seats, cramped car seats and low benches keep tall people bending and hunching for hours. Bodies adapt well, but that steady load often shows up as a stiff, achy back.

Try desk risers or a sit-stand desk near elbow height, a screen lifted to eye level, a deeper seat, the car seat slid back and down, and hinging from the hips at low benches.

Leg numbness, weakness or bladder or bowel changes need prompt attention. Our chiropractors at Hybrid Physio can look at your setup and pair adjustments with exercise. Book online via the link in bio 🦘
